summary: [spec-fidelity] The Then of atip.claim14.15 says 'each stated 1.4 size equals the measure and is smaller than its 1.3 size'. The amended brief lets the tree grow, and it does (22,209 -> 26,847), and the bound test exempts the 'schema (tree)' row (changelog_problems: name != "schema (tree)"). The sentence is false as written and the test is not faithful to it, only to the brief. Reword: 'each stated 1.4 size equals the measure; each command row is smaller than its 1.3 size; the tree row may be larger; the tree plus one command row is smaller than its 1.3 sum' (and, with finding 3, per command). The reworded scenario is then re-reviewed by another actor; this review therefore leaves atip.claim14.15 unsigned.
